abstract: Ovarian malignant germ cell tumors are a diverse set of masses originating from the primitive gonadal germ cells, often in young females. They have useful imaging and clinical features, including serum tumor marker elevation, that may aid the radiologist at the time of diagnosis, and also during follow-up. Accurate and timely diagnosis is essential, as standard-of-care therapies lead to a high rate of cancer remission.
abstract_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍は、原始生殖腺の胚細胞に由来する多様な腫瘤であり、若年女性に多くみられる。血清腫瘍マーカーの上昇を含む有用な画像的・臨床的特徴があり、診断時およびフォローアップ中に放射線科医の助けとなり得る。標準治療により高い寛解率が得られるため、正確かつ迅速な診断が不可欠である。
